paragraphs.name: Situation
paragraphs.plain: What the Amazon applications push is, why Chief called it, and what landed the same day.

groups.label: The transmission, verbatim where Chief ruled

items.t: 9/24, after the tenth launch: "I have several Amazon jobs that I want to apply to … I want to have the best application for each one. I want to be the number one candidate for each."
9/24, later, widening the order from the priority pick to all seven packages: "do everything, roll through it."
Inputs named: the posting links (or job IDs) · the old résumés · a LinkedIn export (PDF) · anything else he has.
Everything lands in `_PRIVATE/bolo83-applications/` — git-ignored; the repo is public and was scrubbed of résumé filenames on 9/24.
9 postings landed (one duplicate link) plus 13 résumé files; the priority read is `_PRIVATE/bolo83-applications/PRIORITY.md` (lead: HR Partner · Prime Air pair · JWO stretch).
Deadlines: Food Safety 9/25 · Video Producer 9/28 — Video Producer was later ruled skipped.
The 9/3 job: the MRO (medical review officer, drug screen) never called and the offer stalled there; by 9/24 later the application no longer shows in Chief's account.
The LinkedIn PDF: the profile was stripped by a break-in down to one entry; it has to be rebuilt from the résumés.
